Good Turkish food in Vietnam
Mar 2025 • Couples
Pasha Restaurant is truly a beautiful Turkish restaurant experience. The food is delicious and the portions are quite hearty. The kebabs and falafel rolls are especially worth trying. The restaurant is beautifully decorated and clean. The service is generally good, but sometimes the attitude of the staff may vary. The menu also offers options for vegetarians. Prices are a bit high by Ho Chi Minh standards, but it’s worth the authentic Turkish/Middle Eastern cuisine experience.
